title: octomeria geraensis
intro: Octomeria geraensis, commonly known as the Gera's orchid, is a species of orchid native to Brazil. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Octomeria geraensis include antioxidant and hepatoprotective effects, as well as potential anti-tumor properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
